message: Review flow: hand checks, auto reviewer, policy, Needs-you inbox

Submit triggers an independent agent reviewer
Review policy: auto-done for low-risk work
TUI Needs-you inbox with approve/reject keys

detail: keeps the human gate meaningful; undo still allowed
